tailscale.visibility: Allow visible tailnet devices to request a connection to this server. Access lasts while this server runs. Tailscale HTTPS and access rules must already be configured. Each first connection still requires your approval.
tailscale.unsupported: This server does not support Tailscale connections. Use Add server or SSH setup.
tailscale.workerIntent: Register a separate outbound Worker on this device for the selected server. Existing Workers keep their own lifetimes.
tailscale.matchingCode: Confirm the matching code on both devices.
tailscale.help: Choose a visible device. Online status does not prove DeliDev availability or grant trust.
tailscale.approvalHelp: The target desktop must approve this exact request. Compare the confirmation code before allowing it.
tailscale.completedHelp: Open a paired client from Saved servers. Registered Workers are managed through Runner Devices.
tailscale.loginRequired.heading: Tailscale login is required.
tailscale.loginRequired.body: Open Tailscale on this computer and sign in. Then refresh Tailscale devices and inspect the original access request.
tailscale.cause.connectionRefused.headin: Could not connect to DeliDev on {{device}}.
tailscale.cause.connectionRefused.body: On {{device}}, start DeliDev and enable Tailscale access, then select Check again.
tailscale.cause.timeout.heading: DeliDev on {{device}} did not respond in time.
tailscale.cause.timeout.body: Make sure {{device}} is awake and online in Tailscale, then select Check again.
tailscale.cause.certificateInvalid.headi: The secure connection to {{device}} could not be verified.
tailscale.cause.certificateInvalid.body: On {{device}}, check that Tailscale HTTPS certificates are enabled and the device clock is correct, then select Check again.
tailscale.cause.unexpectedHttp.heading: {{device}} replied, but not as DeliDev.
tailscale.cause.unexpectedHttp.body: Another service on {{device}} may be using this address. Make sure DeliDev Tailscale access is enabled there, then select Check again.
tailscale.cause.invalidIdentity.heading: DeliDev on {{device}} is not compatible.
tailscale.cause.invalidIdentity.body: Update DeliDev on both devices, then select Check again. Manual pairing and SSH setup remain available.
tailscale.retainedRequestHelp: An earlier request for this connection may have been accepted. Retry that original request before sending another.
tailscale.computerHelp: Choose whether other devices on your tailnet can request a connection to this computer.
tailscale.setupGuidance: Check Tailscale sign-in and HTTPS setup, then refresh devices.
tailscale.disableNote: Disabling access does not change your other Tailscale settings.
tailscale.requestsHelp: Requests stay here until they finish. Resume or cancel the original request, or retry it when its outcome is unconfirmed.
tailscale.requestsUnavailable: Connection requests could not be read. Refresh to try again.
